about.text: A semi-soft cheese, it is one of the most popular cheeses in Chile, it is similar in taste to Tilsit and often has chives or red pepper flakes mixed in.

sources.text: Tilsit-like, from the Aconcagua region, often with chives or red pepper flakes; first Chilean cheese imported into the US (2005)
